title: South Side church music today and her own church
summary: Allen praises the inventiveness of South Side church music; she invites him to her Methodist church and describes its services and choirs.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
